verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Ubuntu Desktop is certified on the Raspberry Pi and delivers a rich developer experience on that Arm board. That is backed by claims that Ubuntu is a primary platform for all major IDEs and toolchains, and that it is lightweight enough to run well on modest hardware. Missing for 10: support for SBCs other than the Raspberry Pi, Pi-specific install or performance documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the full developer desktop runs well on these boards.
